data.name: Bazeel
data.gender_notes: Bazeel is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Bazeel refers to someone who is generous and bounteous. The name Bazeel carries the meaning “Bounteous” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Bazeel usually hope their child will grow to embody bounteous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that embodies the virtue of generosity.
data.etymology: Bazeel belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Bounteous.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bazeel total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: بَزيل
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من البزول، يدل على الشجاعة و الاقتدار
in_arabic.long_meaning: بَزيل هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و مشتق من الفعل بَزَلَ الذي يعني التبختر و التكبر، و يدل على الشجاعة و الاقتدار. استخدم هذا الاسم في العصور الإسلامية المبكرة و تم ذكره في بعض المصادر التاريخية كاسم لأحد الصحابة.

in_urdu.name: بَزِیل
in_urdu.meaning: بہادری اور طاقت کا مظہر، اسلامی نام
in_urdu.long_meaning: بَزِیل ایک عربی ಮೂಲ کا مذکر نام ہے جو بَزَلَ فعل سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے تکبر یا تبختر۔ یہ نام شجاعت اور طاقت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے۔ جنوبی ایشیاء میں مسلمانوں کے ذریعہ اس کا استعمال کیا جاتا ہے اور یہ اسلامی تقالید کا حصہ ہے۔

in_hindi.name: बज़ील
in_hindi.meaning: बहादुरी और ताकत का प्रतीक, एक इस्लामी नाम
in_hindi.long_meaning: बज़ील एक अरबी मूल का पुल्लिंग नाम है जो बज़ल فعل से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है अभिमान या दर्प। यह नाम वीरता और शक्ति को दर्शाता है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में इसका उपयोग किया जाता है और यह एक पारंपरिक नाम है।

in_pashto.name: بزیل
in_pashto.meaning: د زړورتیا او ځواک نښه، یو اسلامی نوم
in_pashto.long_meaning: بزیل د عربي اصلي مذکر نوم دی چی د بَزَلَ فعل څخه اخیستل شوی دی، کوم چی معنی یی د تکبر یا تبختر دی. دا نوم د زړورتیا او ځواک څرګندونه کوي. په افغانستان کې د پښتنو مسلمانو لخوا کارول کیږي او ددوی په کلتور کې ځای لري.

in_english.name: Bazeel
in_english.meaning: A symbol of bravery and strength, an Islamic name
in_english.long_meaning: Bazeel is a masculine name of Arabic origin derived from the verb 'bazala,' meaning to show pride or arrogance. It signifies bravery and power. Historically used in early Islamic periods, it holds significance in Islamic tradition as a name that reflects positive attributes such as courage and might.

data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Bazeel can be seen as a reminder of the importance of generosity and compassion towards others. In Islamic teachings, giving to others is considered a form of worship and a way to draw closer to Allah (God). The name Bazeel can inspire us to be more generous in our actions and to strive towards becoming better servants of Allah.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Bazeel means "adorned with precious stones" or "possessing brilliant jewels." It reflects the inner beauty and richness of the soul, emphasizing the importance of spiritual enrichment and personal growth.
